title: How Yahia Bakour grew Stock Alarm to hundreds of thousands of users and sold it for $500K
summary: A podcast show-notes summary about Yahia Bakour joining a stock-alert app at ~$100 MRR as cofounder and growing it to hundreds of thousands of users, then selling on Acquire for $500K in 2023. The text is written by Acquire's marketer about Yahia, not by him, so it holds no first-person principles.
